movelist.name: Bulk Up
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Attack 1 Combat Stage and raise the user’s Defense 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Bulldoze
movelist.effect: All Legal Targets are lowered 1 Speed Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Take Down
movelist.effect: You may perform a Trip Maneuver against the target as a Free Action.

movelist.name: Synthesis
movelist.effect: The user regains Hit Points equal to half of its full Hit Point value. If it is Sunny, the user gains 2/3 of its full Hit Point value instead. If it is Rainy, Sand Storming or Hailing the user gains 1/4 of their full Hit Point value instead.

movelist.name: Worry Seed
movelist.effect: You choose one of the target’s Abilities. Worry Seed changes that Ability to Insomnia for the remainder of the encounter.

abilities.name: Grass Pelt
abilities.effect: The user gains two ticks worth of Temporary Hit Points.

abilities.name: Sap Sipper
abilities.effect: The user is immune to the damage and effects of Grass-Type attacks. If the user is hit by a Grass-Type attack, they gain +1 CS in their choice of Attack or Special Attack. Defensive.
